requirements.text: The system under test exposes room creation at POST /rooms and accepts a JSON request body containing the fields maxPlayers, mode, and ranked. All in-scope requests use the fixed inputs identity player-a, mode=duel, and ranked=false; these shared preconditions are exercised within the four in-scope scenarios and require no separate test variants.
acceptanceCriteria: A POST request to /rooms carrying a JSON body with the fields maxPlayers, mode, and ranked is accepted for processing by the system.
In-scope requests are issued under identity player-a with mode=duel and ranked=false.

requirements.text: Room creation with the in-scope valid capacity maxPlayers=2: when player-a submits POST /rooms with mode=duel, ranked=false, and maxPlayers=2, the system responds with HTTP status 201. Only the HTTP status code is asserted for this scenario.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /rooms with maxPlayers=2, mode=duel, ranked=false under identity player-a responds with HTTP status 201.

requirements.text: Room creation with the in-scope valid capacity maxPlayers=8: when player-a submits POST /rooms with mode=duel, ranked=false, and maxPlayers=8, the system responds with HTTP status 201. Only the HTTP status code is asserted for this scenario.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /rooms with maxPlayers=8, mode=duel, ranked=false under identity player-a responds with HTTP status 201.

requirements.text: Room creation with the in-scope invalid capacity maxPlayers=1: when player-a submits POST /rooms with mode=duel, ranked=false, and maxPlayers=1, the system responds with HTTP status 400. Only the HTTP status code is asserted for this scenario.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /rooms with maxPlayers=1, mode=duel, ranked=false under identity player-a responds with HTTP status 400.
